why: Hand-written situational practice items for ALL twelve A1.2 Lektionen, in the shape scripts/build-lesson-pool.mjs merges (id `extra-a12-lNN-XX`, so scripts/validate-curriculum.mjs can tell which Lektion an item belongs to and check its lexis under RULE 11). WHY THEY EXIST. docs/course-factory/a12-rebuild/CONTRACT.md §5 measured, with quality.js's filterPool at level a1.2 over grammar-content-cache.json, what the legacy bank can supply per Lektion on its primary slug: eleven Lektionen can fill their seven controlled items out of drill that mentions nothing from their own situation — the finding the four A1.1 DaF reviews spent four rounds on — and Lektion 4 cannot fill them at all, because `negation` keeps 4 of 21 items (13 fail NEGATION_WITHOUT_CUE: the prompt asks for kein/nicht with nothing in the German that calls for a negation, the first BLOCKER of DaF review #1, still unrepaired in the A1.2 bank) and 4 is exactly PRIMARY_MIN, so L4 would draw the same four items on every attempt. THE RULES EVERY ITEM HERE OBEYS, each one a finding of REVIEW-daf-1..5 rather than a preference: (1) the answer follows unambiguously from the GERMAN prompt — a verb gap carries its infinitive in brackets („(nehmen)"), a bare-article gap carries the task formula („(bestimmter Artikel)"), a number gap carries the digit („(480)") and a Dativ chunk carries its parts („(mit + dem)"); (2) typed production only (fill_blank without options, sentence_building, error_correction), German in prompt and answer, `accepted` carries the answer and the lowercase variant exactly where the gap opens the sentence; (3) `caseSensitive: true` only where the capital letter IS the task — the höfliche „Ihnen" in L6 and „Sie" in L9, whose explanations name the capital — and nowhere else (REVIEW #5 BLOCKER 3, measured in both directions by tests/lesson-extra-items-a12.test.mjs); (4) every item is situational: it uses the Wortfeld of its own Lektion, so `relevanceScore` ranks it above the legacy drill and it is actually drawn; (5) RULE 11 with the A1.2 ratchet at 0 — every token of prompt, answer and accepted is a word A1.1 or an earlier A1.2 Lektion has taught, which is why the ASCII fallbacks the A1.1 file carries („dreissig", „fuer") are absent here (the engine compares ae/ä-blind anyway) and why every task formula is one of the strings ITEM_FORMULA_RE strips; (6) no Vorgriff on the grammar: the Akkusativpräpositionen wait for L10 and the Dativ for L11, exactly as the notices sequence them; (7) no explanation claims a percentage, „immer" or „ohne Ausnahme" (MAJOR 7). WHAT THEY DRILL. A topic mark is a routing label, so the guard suite measures the ANSWER: negation items answer nicht/kein-, accusative items den/einen/keinen, question-word items the W-word or the whole question, imperative items the imperative, modal items the Satzklammer, perfekt items the Partizip II, numbers the number word from a digit in the German prompt, stem-changing verbs the CHANGED form (the Sie-form shows no change and does not count), prepositions the preposition or the preposition+article chunk. Measured per Lektion: L1 8/9, L2 9/9, L3 9/11, L4 13/13, L5 9/9, L6 9/10, L7 8/9, L8 9/9, L9 8/9, L10 8/8, L11 9/9, L12 11/11 — 110 of 116. NOT YET MEASURED: src/data/lessonPools/a12.json does not exist (CONTRACT §1 and §6.0 — the pool build, the POOL_LOADERS entry and the route land in one change), so nobody has yet seen the DRAW these items produce. The two pool tests of the A1.1 suite ("the shipped pool contains them", "THE DRAW") have no counterpart in tests/lesson-extra-items-a12.test.mjs and belong in that change.
